exact_statement: For every finite Boolean sign under any interior product measure, any singleton physical block X with bias p, and Shannon entropy in bits, let M_X=H(S_X|S_residual), J_X=I(X;T) in the actual physical-child/spectral experiment, r=min(p,1-p), and delta=1-sqrt(1-r). Then J_X-M_X<=h2(r)-h2(delta). The bound is uniform in dimension, residual biases and Boolean children. Consequently lim_{p->0} sup_{all finite actual Boolean signs and all interior residual product biases}(J_X-M_X)/(p log2(1/p))=1/2. The tax expansion is (r/2)log2(1/r)+((log2(e)-1)/2)r+O(r^2 log(1/r)); exact optimal tax at arbitrary nonzero p and influence/composition payment remain unproved.

exact_statement: For every balanced Boolean core g on a finite uniform cube and k>=1 fresh fair point controls, let q=2^-k and F=1+A_k(g-1). On the physical control-first tree stopped at the first inactive control or at g, A061 one-sided logarithmic charge lambda_s equals the exact magnitude-mismatch KL residual at every active node s: lambda_s=u-u^2+u^2 log2((1-2u+2u^2)/u^2), u=2^-s. Its physically weighted sum is q(k+A_k)<=4kq with A_k=sum_(s=1..k)2^-s[2s-1+log2(1-2^(1-s)+2^(1-2s))]. Queried influence is kq, terminal influence qI(g), and terminal entropy qH(g); no terminal bound on arbitrary cores is implied.
